summary: Phase 4 iteration 5 — frontend-only regression after (1) XSS hardening of AIChat.jsx Markdown renderer (now uses React nodes, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, safeUrl gate for links), (2) stable React keys for messages/templates/tips/partners/perks/upsells (genMessageId + content-derived keys), (3) empty catch blocks in Reviews.jsx now log warnings. RESULTS: ALL TARGET FLOWS PASS. (A) AI CHAT MARKDOWN RENDERING ✅ Sent substantive multi-turn questions (asked for bold/italic/code/list/table/link in one prompt, then 30-yr ELSS plan). Latest assistant bubble innerHTML contains real <strong>, <em>, <ul>, <li> nodes (verified via DOM query) — NOT escaped text, NOT raw '<strong>' artefacts, NOT visible '<strong>' as plain text. Bullets render as proper UL/LI. (B) XSS REGRESSION ✅ Sent prompt embedding '<script>alert(1)</script>' and a '[click](javascript:alert(1))' link. DOM check: hasScriptTag=False, hasJavascriptHref=False. safeUrl gate correctly rewrites disallowed protocols to '#'. React text escaping prevents any active HTML injection from streamed content. (C) AI PNG SNAPSHOT (multi-turn) ✅ ai-chat-download click triggered actual browser download → /tmp/downloads/TFD-AI-planning-1782215443619.png (1.50 MB) capturing latest user+AI pair full content. (D) CALCULATOR PNG REGRESSION ✅ calc-download-png clicked → TFD-sip-calculator.png (795 KB). Upsell scenarios list renders with stable label-derived keys. No React key warnings in console. (E) TOP FUNDS ✅ /api/mf/top-funds returns 15 funds (sample: Nippon India Large Cap, ICICI Pru Large Cap, Axis Large Cap). Section text contains ZERO 'Direct' occurrences (regex match count = 0). Funds-search filters correctly: typing 'parag' narrows the list to a single matching fund. (F) REVIEWS ✅ 3 review cards render with stable keys. Yellow 'Write a Google Review' CTA visible. 'View on Google' header link visible. Star rating click on data-testid='reviews-star-4' works (UI updates). Shuffle template button toggles template content (#1–#8 pills visible). NO console errors emitted by the new warning logs on this page load (no submit was attempted). (G) FLOATING ACTIONS ✅ fab-ai-chat at x=24 (bottom-LEFT, navy gradient + red AI chip). fab-whatsapp at x=1707 (bottom-RIGHT, green WhatsApp brand). (H) VISUAL PALETTE ✅ Hero italic 'your' = navy #024396, 'health' = red #C7102E. Reviews 5-star icons red. AI chat header navy. Brand consistent across hero, calc, reviews, footer. (I) CONSOLE ✅ ONLY the pre-existing 4× Recharts 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warning fires. ZERO new React key warnings, ZERO 'Each child in a list should have a unique key' messages, ZERO dangerouslySetInnerHTML errors, ZERO undefined-reference errors.

design_issues.screen: AI chat streaming response (PRE-EXISTING, also flagged iter3 & iter4 — NOT a regression of XSS hardening)
issues: AI streamed reply still shows duplicated phrase fragments e.g. '30-Year Horizon + ELSS — Poori Baat! 30-Year Horizon + ELSS — Poori Baat!' and 'Compounding apna jaadu dikhati hai — har 7 jaadu dikhati hai — har 7-10 saal'. This survives in the PNG snapshot as well. Root cause is the streaming SSE chunk handler in send() (lines 100-120 of AIChat.jsx), NOT the new Markdown renderer — confirmed by inspecting raw message.content which already contains the duplicated text before Markdown ever runs. The new safe renderer is innocent. Cosmetic only.
Recharts 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warning fires 4× on initial render. Non-blocking. Flagged in iterations 1–4.

action_items: (Pre-existing, carried over from iter4) Fix AI SSE chunk duplication in AIChat.jsx send() handler — currently produces visible double-phrases in streamed text + PNG snapshot. Suggest: collapse immediate exact-line/phrase repeats in the SSE buffer before commit, OR commit only on complete sentence boundaries. Not introduced by this iteration's changes.
(Pre-existing) Silence Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning by guarding ResponsiveContainer with minWidth/minHeight.
critical_code_review_comments: AIChat.jsx Markdown renderer (lines 333-421) is correctly XSS-safe: only React nodes returned, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere in the file (verified by grep). safeUrl gate (lines 423-432) only permits http(s):/mailto: — blocks javascript:, data:, vbscript:. Verified at runtime — malicious '[click](javascript:alert(1))' was neutralised to href='#'.

AIChat.jsx renderInline (lines 436-482) iterates with a safety counter of 500 — guards against catastrophic backtracking on pathological inputs. Tokens use unique React keys derived from tokens.length, eliminating the key-collision risk that motivated this refactor.

Stable message keys: messages.map uses key={m.id || `msg-${i}`} on line 220. genMessageId() produces collision-resistant ids (random + Date.now base36). Welcome message has fixed id 'welcome' for stable identity across re-renders. Send() assigns ids to BOTH user and empty-assistant placeholder before streaming — eliminates the previous key-by-index race during incremental streaming.

Reviews.jsx error logging (lines 127-140) now uses console.warn with context strings instead of swallowing — observable in DevTools without breaking the success UX. Acceptable per the task spec ('the catch blocks now log warnings if backend fails — that is intentional').

Calculators.jsx upsell key uses label-slice → stable across re-renders for any unique label. Partners.jsx partner-name key is stable provided partner names are unique (visually confirmed). WhatsAppCommunityPopup perk-text-slice key is stable. No 'each child in a list' warning observed in console during full nav.
FloatingActions.jsx still uses rel='noreferrer' (not 'noopener noreferrer') on external target=_blank links — minor security nit unchanged since iter4.

rca of the issue: No new bugs introduced by this iteration. Pre-existing AI streaming duplication RCA (carried from iter4): the SSE chunk handler in AIChat.jsx send() appends raw decoded chunks into the assistant message buffer via setMessages; under certain SSE chunk boundaries the backend or the React batching emits overlapping fragments, producing visible duplicate phrases inside message.content. The duplicates are present in the raw stored string BEFORE Markdown rendering — confirmed by reading message.content via page.evaluate. The new safe Markdown renderer faithfully renders whatever is in content, so duplicates remain visible. Mitigation: in the SSE accumulation loop, before commit, collapse consecutive identical sub-strings of length>=10, OR buffer until newline/sentence boundary.
